scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-cli, branch release/0.3.0/refactor/host-neutral-cli; the commit is HEAD on top of 85bd5ba. Diff file: /home/user/holyagent-notes/pr2.diff. The implementer's notes are in the commit message; docs/pi/orchestration.md ('The runtime under Pi') describes the forms.

Regressions: Claude-host behavior and existing commands are unchanged

result:
result: no blockers. All requirements hold, Claude output is unchanged, and `mise run verify` passes.

findings (all non-blocking):
1. `packages/runtime/src/cli/program.ts:~101,~118,~134` and `cli/config.ts` (`agentHostOf`): a bad `HOLYAGENT_HOST` makes `--help`, `<group> --help` and every command that loads config exit 2.
   - Repro: `HOLYAGENT_HOST=Pi holyagent --help` prints the usage error with exit 0 from the pipe, and `HOLYAGENT_HOST=Pi holyagent plan` exits 2.
   - This matches "any other value is a usage error" in `docs/pi/orchestration.md`.
   - `failed()` falls back to Claude for the same bad value, so the help paths are inconsistent with it. `Effect.orElseSucceed(() => "claude")` on the help paths would fix it. Optional.
2. `packages/runtime/src/vcs/message.ts:26`: `PI_SESSION_LINK` uses `\S*` and swallows a closing `)`.
   - Repro: `cleanMessage("fix\n\nSee [session](https://pi.dev/session/#abc) for details")` returns `"fix\n\nSee [session]( for details"`.
   - The existing claude.ai pattern has the same flaw, so this is not a new class of bug.
3. `packages/runtime/src/vcs/message.ts:27-31`: `PI_NAME` strips a `Co-authored-by` trailer whose name is exactly `Pi`, with no tie to the pi.dev address.
   - Repro: `Co-authored-by: Pi <pi@example.com>` is removed.
   - The commit message and the docs state this on purpose. A person actually named Pi is the only loss, and `Pietro` is kept.
4. `packages/runtime/src/domain/host.ts:50,62`: the `workflow:` and `pi-workflow:` strings are hard-coded and duplicate `WORKFLOW_AGENT_PREFIX` and `PI_WORKFLOW_AGENT_PREFIX` in `directive.ts:28,42`. The code that checks the ids and the code that prints them can drift apart. Optional.
5. `packages/runtime/src/cli/assignment.ts:229,293`: for dispatch and record, the Claude-form fields and `forHost` repeat the same text. `assignment close` does the same with `closeNotes(CLAUDE_WORDS)` and `forHost`. The two are built from the same function, so they cannot drift today. Optional.
6. `packages/runtime/src/index.ts:25-37` re-exports `cli/hook.ts` and `cli/overview.ts` internals, and `cli/sessioncontext.ts` and `ROOT_CORE` symbols, which widens the public API. The commit message and docs state it as intended for the Pi extension. Optional.
7. `packages/runtime/src/cli/overview.ts:178`: `reconcile` calls `agentHostOf(env)` itself instead of reading `host` from `config`. Optional.

The `/code-review` skill ran on `85bd5ba...ee51233`, and its seven findings are the seven above. I read each cited line and reproduced findings 1 and 2. Finding 3 is confirmed from the code and docs, and 4 to 7 from the code. I rejected nothing, but ranked all seven as non-blocking.

evidence:
Behavior:
- Host toggle and plan: the "pi host setting toggles workflow availability and plan prints the direct-launch fallback" cases in `packages/runtime/tests/host.test.ts` (lines 101-190) pass. Under pi, unset or `0` prints the direct subagents. `1` prints the workflow with that work as its fallback.
- Agent ids: the pi id forms `pi:<id>` and `pi-workflow:<run-id>/<id>` match pi-subagents. Its direct agent id is `randomUUID().slice(0,17)` (`agent-manager.ts:528`) and its run id is `wf_<12 hex>` (`workflow/task.ts:26`). Neither contains whitespace or `/`, so both pass the `\S+` checks.
- Help under pi: I read the help of every group under `HOLYAGENT_HOST=pi`. None names Claude's Workflow tool, SendMessage or the Read tool. Under pi, `hook` lists only `commit-msg`.
- Commit-message cleaner: it strips the pi footer, the `pi.dev` co-author trailer and the pi session link in my repro (`cleanMessage`). Findings 2 and 3 are the exceptions.
Regressions:
- Claude help output: I diffed the base `85bd5ba` against HEAD with `HOLYAGENT_HOST` unset, across 14 commands and groups, and all are byte-identical.
- Bundled plugin: it is covered by the plugin freshness test in `packages/integrations/claude/tests/plugin.test.ts`, which passes inside verify.
- Gate: `bunx --no-install mise run verify` exited 0 with 1626 pass, 0 fail, type check clean, lint and format clean. The log is at `/home/user/holyagent-notes/review-verify.log`.
Repo standards:
- The added source lines have no try/catch, `new Promise`, async or await.
- The host and workflow-switch decodes use Effect Schema, and failures are the tagged `Usage` error.
- Every new export I read carries JSDoc.
- The one gap is that `agentHostOf` and `workflowsAvailable` decode plain string literals, so `onExcessProperty` does not apply.
findings: the seven findings above.

acceptance.rationale: No blocking findings; non-blocking ones go to a repair round.
